evidence: Searched the reply and both written files for assertions of cost, retention, credentials, download mechanism, metric, date, outcome or alternative not established by the user or original doc. Costs, retention, date, credentials and other alternatives are all left as open questions. However, armazenamento-de-arquivos-de-exportacao.md line 22 asserts a post-change download mechanism: 'Com o arquivo fora do disco de qualquer worker, o download não depende mais de qual worker recebe a request.' This presupposes a worker still receives and serves the download request, which neither the user nor the original doc established for the new design (the reply itself asks 'Quem serve o download agora'). Borderline at best, so unmet.

armazenamento-de-arquivos-de-exportacao.md line 22: 'o download não depende mais de qual worker recebe a request' states, as part of the Mudança section, that a worker (any worker) receives the download request after the change, i.e. that workers serve the download. This matches the check's example 'that any worker serves it', and contradicts the same document's open question at line 39 ('Quem serve o download hoje...'). Borderline is unmet.

Searched the written files for 'Não fazer nada' entries. Mini-doc line 31: 'Não fazer nada. Com dois workers, parte dos downloads devolve 404. Descartada por isso.' The reason contains only the second worker and the 404 from the user's message, with no added deliberation, cost or tickets (analogous to the MET anchor). The original doc's 'Não fazer nada' entry (line 45) is unchanged pre-existing text, not written in this run.
